We’re looking for a collaborative and curious Senior Software Engineer to join our development team at NetApp Instaclustr (www.instaclustr.com).

5 or more years of commercial experience regularly delivering quality software and overcoming technical challenges.
  
  
Demonstrated experience delivering complex technical solutions.
  
  
Proficiency in Java, SQL and at least one other modern programming language - and openness to learning more.
  
  
Strong communication skills and a humble and collaborative nature - essential for working harmoniously with multiple teams.
  
  
A curious mindset with a keen interest in how your work will positively impact customers.

Work within a development team of 3-8 engineers, to build, maintain, and enhance our open-source application platform, which takes care of the whole lifecycle: provisioning infrastructure, installing applications and, most importantly, keeping the applications running reliably in production.

Education

At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.
  
  
NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.

We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.

It specializes in Attitude Determination and Control System (ADCS) components — reaction wheels, star trackers, and torque rods. Headquartered in the US with operations in Bengaluru, India, the company serves satellite manufacturers and LEO constellation developers worldwide.

The team brings deep experience from high-volume space missions and is driven by a commitment to quality, affordability, and speed. The company has raised $2.2M in funding and is building critical infrastructure for the commercial space ecosystem.

At Goldman Sachs, engineering teams are positioned at the centre of the business, building scalable systems, solving complex technical problems and turning data into action. In data engineering roles, the emphasis is on designing, building and maintaining large-scale data platforms, delivering production pipelines, improving reliability and quality, and partnering closely with users of the platform.
  
  
This is a delivery-focused role for engineers who want to build robust data assets in production, work with modern data technologies, and grow over time within the firm. You will contribute to the data models, pipelines and platform capabilities that underpin analytics, operational decision-making and emerging AI use cases, and may also help extend platform tooling where additional functionality is needed.
  
  
**Role Summary**
As a
**Data Engineer**
in the
**Lakehouse and AI Data Platform team,**
you will design, build, test and support data pipelines and curated datasets on the firm’s modern data platform. You will work across ingestion, transformation, modelling, optimisation and data quality, helping to deliver data products that are reliable, scalable and fit for purpose. Where there are gaps in platform functionality, you may also contribute to shared tooling or framework components that improve how the platform is used and operated.
  
  
The role is suited to engineers who are comfortable writing code, working with SQL and distributed data processing, and solving practical delivery problems in a team environment. More experienced candidates may also contribute to technical design, platform standards and the shaping of delivery approaches across a wider set of use cases.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Pipeline Engineering**

* Build, enhance and support batch and streaming data pipelines on the Lakehouse and AI data platform.
* Refactor or modernise existing data flows where needed to improve reliability, performance and maintainability.
* Where needed, build reusable tooling to improve delivery, consistency and operational support.
* Ensure data pipelines are production-ready, well tested and operationally supportable.

**Data Modelling and Curation**

* Develop raw, refined and curated datasets that support analytics, reporting and AI use cases.
* Apply sound data modelling principles to represent business entities, relationships and historical change accurately.
* Work with consumers to shape data products that are usable, well documented and aligned to business needs.

**Data Quality and Reconciliation**

* Implement controls to validate completeness, accuracy and consistency of data across pipelines and datasets.
* Use reconciliation approaches to build confidence in production outputs and investigate breaks where they arise.
* Contribute to clear standards for testing, monitoring and issue resolution.
* Contribute to practical improvements in testing, monitoring or reconciliation tooling where these strengthen platform reliability and day-to-day delivery.

* Strong hands-on programming experience in Python or Java.

* Ability to learn new tools, internal platforms and delivery workflows quickly.

**Role:**
Backend Engineer

**Function:**
Engineering / Backend Development

**Industry:**

**About Company**

A Bengaluru-based enterprise tech startup founded in 2016. The company specializes in paperless digital solutions for financial inclusion and digital transformation across India.

Its platform covers digital identity verification, legal e-signing, document automation, and payment automation. It serves 1,500+ enterprises and 100 million individual users.

The company is RBI-authorized as a payment aggregator and compliant with SEBI, RBI, and UIDAI frameworks. Backed by investors including Groww and Rainmatter, it is built for engineers who care about craft and real-world impact.

**Position Overview**

The company is hiring backend engineers across its revenue-critical product pods — Payments, KYC, and Account Aggregator (AA). Seat assignment is determined at offer based on candidate domain expertise and current pod priority. Engineers own work streams end-to-end: design, build, ship to dates, and operate in production. Raising the bar through design docs, code reviews, and mentoring junior engineers is a core expectation, not optional.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Own committed workstreams end-to-end within the assigned pod — from system design through shipping and production operation.
* Payments seat: contribute to payment orchestrator architecture (Switch, Collect-Console, card mandates, subscriptions, UPI-based OTM PG); prototype on research-track problems in collections and agentic checkout.
* KYC seat: build compliance-grade identity verification APIs and SDK surfaces within CKYC, KRA, and UIDAI regulatory constraints without sacrificing shipping velocity.
* AA seat: design and build the loan underwriting and monitoring rule engine; lead BSA revamp; extend into FIU/FIP consent flows and PFM/AA APIs.
* Apply rigorous systems thinking across all seats — idempotency, reconciliation, partial-failure handling, and auditability in high-stakes financial flows.
* Drive design documentation and code reviews; actively pair with and mentor junior engineers on the pod bench.
* Proactively propose and ship improvements — identify gaps in the system before they are specced and drive them to completion.

**Must Have Criteria**

* 3–7 years of backend engineering experience spanning service design, data modeling, API design, and production failure handling.
* Demonstrated range across multiple backend domains — single-domain-only profiles will not be considered; breadth is a hard requirement.
* Strong systems thinking in high-stakes financial flows: idempotency, reconciliation, partial-failure reasoning, and auditability must be practiced, not theoretical.
* Track record of proposing and shipping something that was not specced — evidence of independent technical conviction.
* Comfortable operating without direct production access, using platform tooling and observability for debugging and incident response.
* Domain depth in at least ONE of: payment rails (UPI, mandate flows, orchestration), identity verification (KYC/KYB, CKYC/KRA/UIDAI), or lending decisioning/data modeling — drives seat assignment.

**Nice to Have**

* Hands-on experience with NPCI/UPI rails, card mandate flows, or payment switch architecture.
* Prior work within UIDAI, CKYC, or KRA ecosystems at compliance grade.
* Experience building rule engines or decisioning systems for loan underwriting or credit monitoring.
* Demonstrated mentoring of junior engineers in a fast-moving, under-resourced team context.
* Exposure to Account Aggregator framework, FIU/FIP consent flows, or BSA-related data pipelines.

**What We Offer**

* Direct ownership of workstreams in the company's highest-priority, revenue-critical product pods.
* Work on infrastructure used by 100M+ individuals and 1,500+ enterprises across regulated financial domains.
* Lean, high-ownership environment at a funded fintech-infra startup with a clear product roadmap and expanding pod surface.
* Bengaluru base with a culture that rewards first-principles thinking and ships-not-slides execution.
